steps.title: Urgent alerts that take the screen
steps.body: An urgent alert can now light up a locked phone and ring like an alarm: slide right to attend, which opens the chat once the phone is unlocked, or left to dismiss. Turn on Full-screen urgent alerts in the app's settings; a one-time setup after installing offers it, along with ringing through Do Not Disturb. While the phone is in use it rings as a notification at the top, as before.
